name: omniroute
title: OmniRoute
description: Self-hosted AI gateway with a unified OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MCP/A2A support, fallback, and Redis-backed caching. Includes the Redis sidecar.
notes: Dashboard and /v1 proxy on port 20128. All ports bind to loopback. Redis is internal and not published to the host. Application settings (API keys, auth, providers) are configured in the dashboard after first boot.

env.name: OMNIROUTE_VERSION
env.label: OmniRoute image tag
env.description: Full image tag from Docker Hub (e.g. latest, latest-web, latest-bun, latest-web-bun, or a pinned version).

env.name: DASHBOARD_PORT
env.label: Dashboard port
env.description: Host port for the dashboard and /v1 proxy.

env.name: API_PORT
env.label: API port
env.description: Host port for the dedicated API listener.

env.name: LIVE_WS_PORT
env.label: Live WebSocket port
env.description: Host port for the live WebSocket service.
